mapper.select:
select y.id, y.denglu_zhanghao as dengluZhanghao, y.xingming, y.xingbie, y.shouji, y.youxiang, y.touxiang, y.zhuangtai, y.zuihou_denglu_shijian as zuihouDengluShijian, y.chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian, group_concat(distinct j.id order by j.id) as jueseIds, group_concat(distinct j.juese_bianma order by j.id separator ',') as jueseBianmaList, group_concat(distinct j.juese_mingcheng order by j.id separator '、') as jueseMingchengList, case when sum(case when j.juese_bianma = 'admin' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then '管理员' when sum(case when j.juese_bianma = 'huli' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then '护理员' when sum(case when j.juese_bianma = 'jiashu' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then '家属' else '未分配' end as yonghuLeixing, hr.id as huliRenyuanId, hr.gonghao as huliGonghao, js.id as jiashuId, js.laoren_id as jiashuLaorenId from xitong_yonghu y left join yonghu_juese yj on y.id = yj.yonghu_id left join xitong_juese j on yj.juese_id = j.id left join huli_renyuan hr on y.id = hr.yonghu_id left join jiashu_xinxi js on y.shouji = js.shouji and js.shi_moren = 1
and y.denglu_zhanghao like concat('%', #{dengluZhanghao}, '%')
and y.xingming like concat('%', #{xingming}, '%')
and y.zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}
and exists ( select 1 from yonghu_juese fyj join xitong_juese fj on fyj.juese_id = fj.id where fyj.yonghu_id = y.id and fj.juese_bianma = #{jueseBianma} )
group by y.id, y.denglu_zhanghao, y.xingming, y.xingbie, y.shouji, y.youxiang, y.touxiang, y.zhuangtai, y.zuihou_denglu_shijian, y.chuangjian_shijian, hr.id, hr.gonghao, js.id, js.laoren_id order by y.id desc
select id, denglu_zhanghao as dengluZhanghao, xingming, xingbie, shouji, youxiang, touxiang, zhuangtai, chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian from xitong_yonghu where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update xitong_yonghu set denglu_zhanghao = #{dengluZhanghao}, xingming = #{xingming}, xingbie = #{xingbie}, shouji = #{shouji}, youxiang = #{youxiang}, touxiang = coalesce(#{touxiang}, '/uploads/avatar/user-default.jpg') where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select j.id, j.juese_bianma as jueseBianma, j.juese_mingcheng as jueseMingcheng, j.miaoshu, case when yj.id is null then 0 else 1 end as yiFenpei from xitong_juese j left join yonghu_juese yj on j.id = yj.juese_id and yj.yonghu_id = #{yonghuId} order by j.id
select id, juese_bianma as jueseBianma, juese_mingcheng as jueseMingcheng, '启用' as zhuangtai, miaoshu, chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian from xitong_juese order by id
mapper.insert: insert into xitong_juese (juese_bianma, juese_mingcheng, miaoshu) values (#{jueseBianma}, #{jueseMingcheng}, #{miaoshu})
mapper.select: select id, yonghu_id as yonghuId, gonghao, xingming, shouji, zhuangtai from huli_renyuan where zhuangtai != '离职' order by id desc

select js.id, js.laoren_id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming, js.xingming, js.guanxi, js.shouji, js.shi_moren as shiMoren from jiashu_xinxi js join laoren_xinxi l on js.laoren_id = l.id order by js.id desc
